name: How much does garage door frame repair typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does garage door frame repair typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the extent of damage, the materials used, and whether structural wall framing behind the trim is compromised. Repairing a localized section of rotted jamb or replacing exterior trim typically costs significantly less than rebuilding the entire rough opening and replacing the structural header. Upgrades like wrapping the exterior in aluminum or installing rot-resistant composite trim also affect the final price. A hands-on contractor will assess whether structural framing, drywall patching, or paint matching is needed to restore the opening.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on whether you need a simple trim splice, rotted jamb replacement, or full rough opening reconstruction involving structural framing and drywall.
